bounded_slice.name: skillzip_deterministic_entrypoint_chat_native_runnability_probe
bounded_slice.tested_scope: Exact pinned README and compress_demo.py inspection plus one actual local-container checkout attempt. No claim is made about uninspected package modules, headline paper results, or Zip-on-Write numerical behavior.
observations: At the pinned commit, README.md states that the deterministic path runs fully offline, uses Python 3.8+ and the standard library only, and that model assistance is optional via cli=None or --no-llm.

At the pinned commit, compress_demo.py imports only the local skillzip package plus os/sys, calls compress_oneshot(..., cli=None), and explicitly labels that invocation as the deterministic parser/relation-checker path with no network.

The model-assisted route is not a zero-quota acceptance route because the documented CLI path can use an external OpenAI-compatible endpoint, DASHSCOPE_API_KEY and requests; this slice therefore excludes it from acceptance consideration.

A real Chat-local container checkout was attempted with git clone at the exact source repository and failed with 'Could not resolve host: github.com'. The repository was therefore not executable from that network route in this invocation.

The exposed GitHub connector did read the exact pinned README.md and compress_demo.py blobs, so lightweight source transport is available, but this slice did not establish a complete connector-to-local-filesystem materialization path for all package files needed to execute the demo.

missing_tool_or_transport.detail: container git network path cannot resolve github.com; no repository checkout occurred

quota_exhaustion.result: source-level keyless path identified but mechanical execution not yet completed

classification.reason: Source inspection strongly supports a zero-external-quota deterministic route, but current policy requires actual mechanical reproduction with exposed Chat tools; the executable checkout/materialization step was not completed.
